SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%x-W%v') DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
AS period, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM ord_order o WHERE AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT t.orderCount, t.salesAmount, CASE WHEN t.orderCount > 0 THEN ROUND(t.salesAmount / t.orderCount) ELSE 0 END AS avgOrderAmount, t.wxAmount, t.walletAmount, IFNULL(r.refundCount, 0) AS refundCount, IFNULL(r.refundAmount, 0) AS refundAmount FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_channel = 1 THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wxAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_channel = 2 THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS walletAmount FROM ord_order o WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND ) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS refundCount, IFNULL(SUM(pr.amount), 0) AS refundAmount FROM pay_refund pr JOIN ord_order o2 ON o2.id = pr.order_id AND o2.store_id = #{storeId} WHERE pr.status = 2 AND pr.refund_time >= #{start} AND pr.refund_time < #{end}) r ON 1 = 1

SELECT i.product_id AS productId, i.product_name AS productName, SUM(i.qty) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM ord_order_item i JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status IN (2, 3, 4, 5) AND o.pay_time >= #{start} GROUP BY i.product_id, i.product_name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS salesAmount, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM ord_order o LEFT JOIN fra_store s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE GROUP BY o.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM ord_order o WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fra_store WHERE status = 1 AND del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_store_material_stock s JOIN bom_material m ON m.id = s.material_id WHERE m.warn_threshold IS NOT NULL AND s.stock_qty <= m.warn_threshold
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_store_material_stock s JOIN bom_material m ON m.id = s.material_id

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, s.material_id AS materialId, m.material_name AS materialName, s.stock_qty AS stockQty, m.warn_threshold AS warnThreshold, CASE WHEN m.warn_threshold IS NOT NULL AND s.stock_qty <= m.warn_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS warn FROM inv_store_material_stock s JOIN bom_material m ON m.id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN fra_store st ON st.id = s.store_id ORDER BY warn DESC, s.stock_qty ASC, s.store_id, m.material_name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.material_id AS materialId, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, DATE(l.create_time) AS statDate, SUM(-l.change_qty) AS qty FROM inv_stock_log l JOIN bom_material m ON m.id = l.material_id JOIN (SELECT material_id FROM inv_stock_log WHERE biz_type IN (1, 2, 3) AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} AND store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY material_id ORDER BY SUM(-change_qty) DESC LIMIT #{limit}) top ON top.material_id = l.material_id WHERE l.biz_type IN (1, 2, 3) AND l.create_time >= #{start} AND l.create_time < #{end} AND l.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY l.material_id, m.material_name, m.unit, DATE(l.create_time) ORDER BY l.material_id, statDate
